name: Ferrofish
_refused: ferrofish.com/terms-of-service/, « Copyright notice »: « The photos posted on our website and the texts created by us are protected by copyright. » followed by « Unauthorized copying and publication of these (even in part) will be prosecuted ». A specification row is text created by them, and this catalogue quotes it, so the clause reaches what we do. Refused on the same reading as Luxman and Gold Note: the words « even in part » leave no room for a narrower one. NO DEVICE RECORD MAY BE WRITTEN until Ferrofish is asked and answers.
_what_was_discarded: Four multichannel converters with the richest ADAT and MADI channel tables met anywhere - the PULSE16 MX gives « 64 channels @32kHz, 44.1kHz, 48kHz », « 32 channels @64kHz, 88.2kHz, 96kHz », « 16 channels @128kHz, 176.4kHz, 192kHz » for MADI and the equivalent SMUX ladder for ADAT - plus « DAC: ESS ES9017 », « DNR: 120 dB », « THD+N: -110 dB » on the PULSE16 AE.
